assumptions: Boss-only synthetic V3 states; full HP/MP/potions, four checkpoint builds, uniformly accumulated Rifts, no LR. Progression gear: 2+floor/40 R (cap10), 2+floor/70 SR (cap13), 3+floor/120 SSR (cap12), from350 floor/200 clean UR (cap4). Levels R/SR 1+floor/50, SSR 1+floor/100, UR 1+floor/200, rounded down. Thin gear instead uses five SSR at 1+floor/200. Equipped builds test viability, not typical loot or 999-floor completion. Policy reads public clues.
